text: This recommendation approves the entering into of service agreements between Build Toronto Inc. (BTI) and CreateTO, and between Toronto Port Lands Company (TPLC) and CreateTO in order to further the business operations of both BTI and TPLC.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Approved the entering into of the Service Agreement between Build Toronto Inc. and Create TO, and the Service Agreement between Toronto Port Lands Company and CreateTO as presented in Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (March 6, 2018) from the Head, Legal and Corporate Secretary, CreateTO.
